typology.name: Rapid Fan-Out / Collection
typology.description: A single source distributes funds to 15+ wallets simultaneously, then those wallets converge their balances into one or two collection points. This is a common pattern in mixing services and automated laundering networks.
indicators: Single wallet sending to 15+ recipients in a short window
Recipients forward funds to 1-2 collection wallets
Collection wallets receive from no other sources

freeze_priority.recommendation: Immediate review required. Funds are actively moving through a high-risk pattern.

known_actor.risk_label: High behavioral similarity to Lazarus Group
known_actor.lazarus_profile: North Korean state-sponsored group known for cryptocurrency exchange hacks. Typically uses rapid multi-hop relay chains, cross-chain bridges, and mixers to launder stolen funds within 24-48 hours of theft.
